frames.role: Corona dorada que aparece sobre el tanque líder (#1 en ranking)
frames.prompt: A cartoon golden crown icon, slightly elevated front view (like a UI badge), bold dark charcoal outline, cel-shaded style, isolated on transparent background, centered. STYLE: vibrant warm cartoon game UI, Brawl Stars quality. Crown shape: a bold base band with 3 upward points (middle tallest), simple and iconic — instantly reads as a crown at 48x48px. Rich bright gold (#FFD700) with smooth cel-shading: bright warm yellow-white highlight on top face, rich golden mid-tone, warm orange-gold shadow. Subtle warm sparkle/gleam highlights. Clean, premium, bold — no gems or excessive decoration. NOT realistic, NOT pixel art, NO text, NO watermark.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic jewels, detailed decoration, pixel art, text, watermark, background scenery, 3D render, complex ornate design

phaser_config.notes: Se posiciona sobre el tanque líder. origin.y = 1.0 para que la base de la corona quede en el punto de referencia (justo encima del tanque). Visible solo cuando player.isLeader === true.
